_comment: S4e spec §4.2: hand-written synthetic turns with a GENUINE own question, GP style (English, STT fragments, hesitations). INVENTED -- no real speech; no participant speech appears in this file. In the two own_after_card_rejected turns (s-09, s-10) the asker reads generated card text aloud on purpose (a shown card, then rejected), and that card text is also invented. Cards are borrowed by reference from the carrier GP turn at load time, never copied here. Each truth_question was checked against its carrier's 3 cards with own_question_match.card_match -> None (scripts/own-question-turn-dump.py --check-synthetic). Reported as its own slice, never mixed into the real-slice numbers.
